name: Altos Terrace Residences
constructionStatus: off_plan
description: Eighty homes in eight blocks stepping up a hillside at Altos de los Monteros, Marbella, every one turned to the sea. Twelve of the twenty released are available, from EUR 540,000 before tax.
overview: Eight blocks of ten homes at Altos de los Monteros, on the hillside above Marbella's eastern coast. The blocks do not sit level with each other. Each one is set a step higher than the block to its south, so that no home looks into the roof of its neighbour and every one of the eighty is turned to the sea.
why: A hillside site handled as a piece of engineering rather than a view, and a payment schedule that leaves most of the money until the keys.
location: On the hillside behind Los Monteros, east of Marbella town, with the sea in front and the Sierra Blanca foothills behind.

name: Armani Residences Marbella
constructionStatus: Off-plan, pre-sale; delivery planned for Q2 2028 per the developer
description: Armani Residences Marbella: 33 branded residences with Armani/Casa interiors in Nagüeles, above Marbella’s Golden Mile. Nine buildings on 50,000 sqm, private pools, a spa and delivery planned for Q2 2028. From EUR 4,750,000.
overview: Armani Residences Marbella is a development of 33 residences in nine buildings of four floors, arranged in three terraced rows on a 50,000 sqm plot on Avenida de las Piedras, in Nagüeles, above Marbella’s Golden Mile. The interiors are designed by the Armani/Casa Interior Design Studio. Every residence has a private pool. The three types range from 200 to 500 sqm of interior built area, with three to seven bedrooms, and from 400 to 1,400 sqm in total once terraces and gardens are counted. All face north and south. The development is entirely pedestrian at surface level, with 116 underground parking spaces and three independent entrances. It is being sold off plan, by private appointment, with delivery planned for the second quarter of 2028.
why: A factual look at what the developer’s documents say, without any promise of returns.
location: On Avenida de las Piedras in Nagüeles, elevated above Marbella’s Golden Mile at the foot of Sierra Blanca, with the beach clubs, Puerto Banús and the golf courses a short drive away.

name: Playa del Ángel Residences
constructionStatus: off_plan
description: Four homes left of 48 on the Estepona beachfront: three apartments and one of the six seafront villas, in a gated scheme with a spa, a gym and a padel court.
overview: A gated scheme on a 33,346 sqm beachfront plot at Playa del Ángel, between Estepona and the New Golden Mile. Six seafront villas stand at the front. Behind them, five three-storey buildings hold 42 apartments and penthouses, every one turned to the sea. All vehicle circulation is underground.
why: Genuine beachfront on this coast is close to finished, and this is one of the last schemes being built on it.
location: A gated beachfront scheme between Estepona town and the New Golden Mile, with the coastal path and a sculpture park alongside it.

name: Design Hills Marbella
constructionStatus: Off-plan; no delivery date in the developer’s documents; the plans are project-stage
description: Design Hills Marbella: residences designed with Dolce&Gabbana in five blocks on Marbella’s Golden Mile, with marble and majolica interiors, a private club, pools and a retail drive. From EUR 4,750,000.
overview: Design Hills Marbella is a development of residences designed by Dolce&Gabbana in collaboration with Sierra Blanca Estates, on the Golden Mile of Marbella. It is arranged in five blocks, each named after an Italian city: DG Venezia, DG Palermo, DG Firenze, DG Como and DG Napoli. The residences range from one to five bedrooms in the developer’s description, with ground-floor apartments called Piazza, penthouses called Belvedere and a furniture design by Dolce&Gabbana. The developer’s May 2026 price list covers nine residences in blocks one to four, from EUR 4,750,000 to EUR 17,500,000. Beyond the homes, the development is planned as a private club, with infinity and indoor pools, a beach club, restaurants, a spa, sports courts including an indoor five-a-side football pitch, a children’s club and a retail drive.
why: A factual look at what the developer’s documents say, without any promise of returns.
location: On the hill above Puente Romano, in the heart of Marbella’s Golden Mile, with the beach, the golf courses and the Marbella Club within a few minutes.

name: Cortijo Blanco Villa Collection
constructionStatus: under_construction
description: Seven contemporary villas in a gated pocket of Cortijo Blanco, Marbella, each with four en-suite bedrooms, a private pool and an optional rooftop solarium.
overview: Cortijo Blanco Villa Collection is a gated enclave of seven independent villas in Cortijo Blanco, one of the established residential pockets between San Pedro de Alcántara and Puerto Banús. The beach promenade, the restaurants along it, the centre of San Pedro and Puerto Banús itself are all reachable on foot. Each villa is arranged over three floors and a rooftop. The ground floor opens the kitchen, living and dining areas onto a covered terrace, a barbecue terrace and a 56 m² pool. Four en-suite bedrooms sit above and below: the master and two more on the first floor, a fourth beside the basement family room. A lift serves all three levels, and an optional rooftop solarium adds a further 139.85 m² with its own pool and pergola.
why: Villas this size, in a gated setting, within walking distance of both the beach and Puerto Banús are the scarce end of the Marbella market. Cortijo Blanco is already built out, so the supply does not repeat.
location: An established, level neighbourhood a few streets back from the beach, with the promenade, restaurants, San Pedro centre and Puerto Banús all within walking distance.

name: Elviria Hills Residences
constructionStatus: off_plan
description: An 88-home gated collection of 2-4 bedroom apartments, penthouses and garden villas in an elevated pocket of Elviria West, with resort-style amenities and open views toward the mountains and sea.
overview: Elviria Hills Residences brings 88 apartments, penthouses with private solariums and garden villas to an elevated setting in Elviria West, eastern Marbella, with open views toward the mountains and the sea on the horizon. Residents have access to three outdoor pools, two children's pools, a heated indoor pool, an indoor and outdoor coworking area, a spa with sauna and Turkish bath, a gym and landscaped gardens, all within a gated, 24-hour secured community. Elviria's shops, restaurants and beach clubs are around five minutes away, with Marbella centre roughly 15 minutes and Malaga airport around 30 minutes by car.
why: Elviria Hills Residences suits buyers who want a quiet, elevated, amenity-rich setting in a growing part of eastern Marbella, close to the beach clubs and golf courses of Elviria without the density of the town centre.
location: Elviria Hills Residences sits in an elevated setting in Elviria West, a growing area of eastern Marbella close to golf courses, beach clubs and Elviria's own shops and restaurants.
distances: Rio Real Golf & Santa Maria Golf nearby

name: Rio Real Townhouses
constructionStatus: completed
description: A completed collection of 27 semi-detached 4 and 5 bedroom houses in Rio Real, Marbella, built across basement, ground and first floor levels with a private rooftop solarium and pool.
overview: Rio Real Townhouses is a completed collection of 27 semi-detached houses in one of Marbella's established neighbourhoods, built across basement, ground and first floor levels with a private rooftop solarium and swimming pool on every home. Residents have access to a communal outdoor pool, a gym with sauna, Turkish bath and massage room, and landscaped communal gardens, all within a gated, underground-parking community. Rio Real's beach is around 5 minutes away, with Marbella's town centre roughly 10 minutes by car.
why: Rio Real Townhouses suits buyers who want a completed, move-in-ready home in an established Marbella neighbourhood, with the privacy of a private rooftop pool alongside communal wellness facilities.
location: Rio Real Townhouses sits in the established Rio Real neighbourhood of Marbella, close to the beach, golf and Marbella's town centre.
distances: Rio Real Golf & Country Club nearby

name: Benahavís Ridge Residences
constructionStatus: off_plan
description: A small collection of elevated homes with open terraces, sea views and a quieter coastal setting.
overview: Benahavís Ridge is twenty-one homes on a hillside above the golf valley, arranged in staggered blocks so that no home stands in another's shadow. Interiors run from 95 to 186 m², with terraces of 35 to 75 m² facing south and south-east towards the Mediterranean.
why: This project suits buyers who want space, privacy and open views in Benahavís, within a short drive of Puerto Banús and Nueva Andalucía.
location: The site sits in the hills of Benahavís, the inland corner of the triangle it forms with Marbella and Estepona -- the densest concentration of golf courses in Europe. Nueva Andalucía and Puerto Banús are about ten and twelve minutes down the valley.

name: Bel Air Villa Collection
constructionStatus: off_plan
description: A collection of 15 independent 4-bedroom villas in Bel Air on the New Golden Mile, between Estepona and Marbella, with private pools, pool bar and optional basement and solarium.
overview: The Bel Air Villa Collection is a development of 15 independent villas in the established Bel Air urbanisation, on the New Golden Mile between Estepona and Marbella. Each villa sits on its own plot with a private pool, landscaped garden and covered pool bar. Every villa shares the same 581.72 m² built layout across ground and first floors: four en-suite bedrooms, an open-plan kitchen and a main living room with ceilings approaching six metres. A basement and a rooftop solarium are available as options on each plot.
why: The Bel Air Villa Collection suits buyers who want an independent villa on its own plot, rather than a unit in an apartment block, within walking distance of the coast on the New Golden Mile.
location: The collection sits in Bel Air, on the New Golden Mile between Estepona and Marbella, with quick access to both and to Málaga airport.

name: Cancelada Park
constructionStatus: off_plan
description: A low-rise collection of garden apartments and penthouses on the New Golden Mile, pairing generous private outdoor space with access to a wider resort setting.
overview: Cancelada Park is a low-rise residential collection on the New Golden Mile. The homes are planned around private terraces, gardens and open living areas, with two parking spaces and a storage room included for each residence. The location works for buyers who want the coast, Estepona and Puerto Banús within easy reach without living in the middle of a busier town centre. A wider resort plan adds wellness, sport, dining and work facilities nearby.
why: The practical appeal is the combination of usable outdoor space, a calmer New Golden Mile setting and facilities that support both longer stays and second-home use.
location: Cancelada sits between Estepona and Marbella, with direct access to the coastal road and the beach close by. It offers a calmer residential base while keeping the main western Costa del Sol destinations within reach.

name: Marbella West Garden Residences
constructionStatus: under_construction
description: A resort-style collection of 139 light-filled residences near San Pedro and Puerto Banús, with extensive wellness spaces and the beach within walking distance.
overview: Marbella West Garden Residences brings together 139 homes around planted courtyards, pools and spaces for wellness, work and family life. It is a large, amenity-led project, but the architecture is arranged to keep outdoor living and natural light at the centre of each home. The location is practical as well as attractive: the beach is described by the developer as a 10-minute walk, Puerto Banús is around five minutes by car, and San Pedro's everyday services are close by.
why: This is a strong fit for buyers who want the services of a resort without giving up the independence of a private home or the convenience of being close to San Pedro and Puerto Banús.
location: The project sits in a growing part of Marbella West with quick access to the A-7 and AP-7. San Pedro, Guadalmina, international schools, healthcare, sport and golf are all close, while the beach and promenade can be reached on foot.

name: Vega Verde Residences
constructionStatus: under_construction
description: An avant-garde development in Nueva Andalucia's Golf Valley, pairing contemporary architecture with resort-style amenities minutes from Puerto Banús.
overview: Vega Verde Residences sits in Nueva Andalucia, one of Marbella's most established addresses, surrounded by golf courses and a short drive from Puerto Banús and Marbella centre. Contemporary architecture, floor-to-ceiling glazing and generous terraces are paired with a full resort-style amenity offer, from an indoor heated pool to a golf simulator and sky bar.
why: This project suits buyers who want contemporary design, a full amenity offer and an established, well-connected Golf Valley address.
location: Vega Verde Residences sits in Nueva Andalucia, surrounded by golf courses and close to Puerto Banús, central Marbella and Malaga Airport.

name: Alisios Residences
constructionStatus: under_construction
description: A boutique collection of 34 apartments and penthouses in Guadalmina Golf, Marbella, framed by golf-course views and close to San Pedro Alcántara and Puerto Banús.
overview: Alisios Residences is a collection of 34 apartments and penthouses set in the Alta de Guadalmina area of Marbella, one of the Costa del Sol's most established addresses, close to San Pedro Alcántara and Puerto Banús. Wide glazing and generous terraces are designed around the Guadalmina golf course and sea views, paired with a gated resort-style amenity offer that includes a pool, gym and co-working space.
why: This project suits buyers who want golf-course and sea views, a gated resort-style setting and easy access to San Pedro and Puerto Banús.
location: Alisios Residences sits in Guadalmina, between San Pedro Alcántara and Puerto Banús, surrounded by some of the Costa del Sol's best golf courses.

name: Aloha Forest
constructionStatus: under_construction
description: A gated collection of two- and three-bedroom apartments and penthouses in Marbella's Golf Valley, minutes from Puerto Banús and the Golden Mile.
overview: Aloha Forest brings 16 apartments and penthouses to a gated setting in Marbella's Golf Valley, within walking distance of Aloha Golf and the international school, and minutes from Puerto Banús, Las Brisas Golf and the Golden Mile. The development is being delivered in two phases. Phase I -- the 16 residences currently available -- began construction in 2024, has a fully finished show apartment, and is due for handover in 2026. A second, larger phase is planned to follow.
why: Aloha Forest suits buyers who want a quiet, gated residential setting that is still walking distance from golf and international schooling, with Puerto Banús and the Golden Mile a short drive away.
location: The development sits in the Aloha area of Nueva Andalucia, between Marbella's Golf Valley and the Golden Mile.

name: Jardin del Mar Residences
constructionStatus: off_plan
description: A gated community of two- and three-bedroom apartments and penthouses on the New Golden Mile in Estepona, with a private spa, gym, cinema and coworking lounge.
overview: Jardin del Mar Residences brings a gated collection of apartments and penthouses to the New Golden Mile, arranged across six low-density blocks around landscaped courtyards and a communal pool. Residents have access to a private spa with sauna and hammam, an indoor pool, a gym with a Pilates studio, a cinema and games room, a coworking lounge and an on-site restaurant -- all within the gated grounds. The beach is a short walk away, with Puerto Banús around 10 minutes and Estepona's old town around 17 minutes by car.
why: Jardin del Mar Residences suits buyers who want resort-style amenities with the beach a short walk away, rather than a car-dependent hillside or golf-valley setting.
location: The development sits on the New Golden Mile, the coastal stretch between Estepona and San Pedro de Alcantara.

name: El Campanario Golf Villa
constructionStatus: Off-plan, planning permission granted, delivery Q4 2026 / Q1 2027
description: A four-bedroom detached villa on the golf front line at El Campanario, Estepona, with a private pool, media room and a rooftop solarium, across a semi-basement, ground and first floor.
overview: El Campanario Golf Villa is a single detached house on the golf front line at El Campanario, Estepona, arranged over a semi-basement, ground floor and first floor with a private pool and garden. The ground floor holds an open living and dining room of 37.90 sqm with a separate 23.60 sqm dining area and a 16.00 sqm kitchen, opening to a 28.06 sqm covered porch, a 31.75 sqm solarium and the pool. Two bedrooms sit on the first floor and two more in the semi-basement, alongside a 24.30 sqm media room and a 14.34 sqm games room. Planning permission has been granted and the developer gives delivery as Q4 2026 to Q1 2027.
why: A detached golf-front villa with its own pool, at a price point where much of the market is townhouses or apartments. It is the last villa in its phase.
location: An established golf urbanisation on the New Golden Mile, with the clubhouse inside it and the coast a short drive south.

name: Nueva Alcántara Residences
constructionStatus: off_plan
description: A 19-home boutique development of 1-3 bedroom apartments and duplex penthouses in San Pedro Alcántara, a short walk from the beach, with a rooftop pool, gym and solarium.
overview: Nueva Alcántara Residences brings 19 apartments and duplex penthouses to a corner plot in San Pedro Alcántara, on Marbella's western side, a 10-minute walk from Playa San Pedro Alcántara and the town's own shops, cafés and pedestrian streets. Residents have access to a rooftop swimming pool with mountain and sea views, a gym, a rooftop solarium finished in artificial grass, private parking with EV charging, and storage rooms, all within a small, low-density building rather than a large complex.
why: Nueva Alcántara Residences suits buyers who want a walkable, beach-close base in San Pedro Alcántara without the scale of a large resort-style complex.
location: Nueva Alcántara Residences sits in San Pedro Alcántara, a walkable, established part of western Marbella close to the beach, with easy access to Puerto Banús and the A-7.

name: Sierra Bermeja Residences
constructionStatus: Under construction, delivery Q3 2027
description: Sierra Bermeja Residences, Casares: 36 two- and three-bedroom apartments stepping down a hillside beside the Sierra Bermeja Nature Park, each with a garage space and storeroom.
overview: Sierra Bermeja Residences is a gated development of 36 apartments with one, two and three bedrooms, arranged so the blocks step down the slope and most homes look out over the sea and the mountains. Every apartment comes with a garage space and a storeroom. Kitchens are fitted, hot water is produced by aerothermics and there is pre-installation for electric vehicle charging. Ground floor apartments have a private garden. The communal areas hold a swimming pool, gardens and a children's playground.
why: Space, views and a garage for a price that buys far less in central Marbella, in a village setting between the sea and Sierra Bermeja.
location: A hillside plot in Casares, beside the Sierra Bermeja Nature Park, under 15 minutes from Estepona and about 30 from Marbella.

name: AÍDA
constructionStatus: Off-plan, building licence granted
description: AÍDA, furnished by Bentley Home: eight residences on Marbella’s Golden Mile, a few minutes’ walk from Puente Romano and the Marbella Club, with a private pit lane. Developed by RGZ Developers.
overview: AÍDA is a boutique collection of just eight residences on Marbella’s Golden Mile, developed by RGZ Developers and furnished by Bentley Home, a few minutes’ walk from Puente Romano and the Marbella Club. There are two types of residence. The Duplex Ground Floor has 4 bedrooms, a private garden and pool, and a lower level with a lounge, private gym, bar and sauna. The Skyline Penthouse has 3 bedrooms, a solarium and a private pool, with views of the sea and La Concha. Each owner has a pitbox on the project’s private pit lane.
why: AÍDA suits buyers who want a rare, ultra-boutique address on Marbella’s Golden Mile, with interiors by Bentley Home and a pitbox on a private pit lane.
location: AÍDA sits on Marbella’s Golden Mile, its most prestigious stretch of coastline, home to luxury resorts, fine dining, designer boutiques and private members’ clubs.

name: La Resina Valley Villas
constructionStatus: Under construction; villas 1-4 started with first occupation licence estimated Q3 2026, villas 5-8 licence granted with completion estimated Q4 2027
description: Six of twelve detached villas available at La Resina on the New Golden Mile, between Estepona and Marbella: plots of 1,000 to 2,010 sqm, a private pool and a lift in every house, and basements that can be fitted out to as many as seven bedrooms.
overview: La Resina Valley Villas is a gated scheme of twelve detached houses in a wooded valley at La Resina, on the New Golden Mile between Estepona and Marbella. Six are available. Each sits on its own plot of 1,000 to 2,010 sqm with a private pool, a garden, covered and uncovered terraces and parking. Every house has a four-stop lift running from the garage to the solarium. The houses are delivered with three bedrooms, but the basement runs from 236 to 465 sqm and is fitted out to the buyer's brief, which the developer takes to as many as seven bedrooms and seven bathrooms. Of the six available, built areas run from 508.43 to 976.52 sqm including the basement, terraces from 278.35 to 467.06 sqm. Prices are net and exclude VAT and transfer taxes.
why: A factual look at what makes these villas relevant now, without any promise of future returns.
location: A gated scheme of twelve villas in a valley at La Resina, on the New Golden Mile between Estepona and Marbella.

name: Mijas Golf Park Residences
constructionStatus: Off-plan
description: One hundred and fifteen apartments and penthouses beside Mijas Golf, eighty-three still available, in six portals stepped along a landscaped park with a pool, a gym, a sauna and a coworking room.
overview: Six portals in three blocks, stepped along a landscaped park on the edge of Mijas Golf, eight minutes from Fuengirola. One, two and three bedrooms, ground-floor homes with private gardens and penthouses with solariums, the largest of them 229.64 sqm.
why: A factual look at what makes these homes relevant now, without any promise of future returns.
location: A gated scheme of 115 homes beside Mijas Golf, inland of Fuengirola and a few minutes from the AP-7 and the coast.

name: Ocho de Oro
constructionStatus: off_plan
description: Ocho de Oro: eight five-bedroom villas in Nueva Andalucía, Marbella, with interior design by Versace Home, on plots of approximately 2,000 m². Developed by RGZ Developers.
overview: Ocho de Oro is a collection of eight villas in the heart of Nueva Andalucía, Marbella, developed by RGZ Developers, with interior design by Versace Home, on plots of approximately 2,000 m². Each 5-bedroom, 6-bathroom villa spans around 1,100m² of total built area across three floors and a rooftop solarium, with a private pool, an indoor spa pool and gym, and gated, 24-hour secured grounds.
why: Ocho de Oro suits buyers who want a rare, boutique villa address minutes from Puerto Banús, with interiors designed by Versace Home.
location: Ocho de Oro sits in the heart of Nueva Andalucía, minutes from Puerto Banús and Marbella’s Golf Valley.

name: La Cala Sun Townhouses
constructionStatus: Off-Plan
description: Sixty-eight south-facing terraced houses above La Cala de Mijas, twenty-three still available, in eight rows with a pool, a Fit space, a spa and a concierge.
overview: Eight rows of terraced houses stepping down a south-facing slope above La Cala de Mijas, six of the rows with a basement garage and storage room. Three and four bedrooms, 137 to 201 sqm built, every house with a garden, a terrace and a solarium, and many with sea views.
why: A factual look at what makes these homes relevant now, without any promise of future returns.
location: A gated scheme of 68 houses above La Cala de Mijas, between Calanova and Chaparral golf, under a kilometre from the village and about two from the beach.

name: Golf Valley Flex Residences
constructionStatus: off_plan
description: A 43-home villa and apartment collection in Nueva Andalucía's Golf Valley, with a flexible own-and-let ownership model, resort-style amenities and a kids' club.
overview: Golf Valley Flex Residences brings 43 villas and apartments to Nueva Andalucía's Golf Valley, minutes from Puerto Banús and surrounded by some of the Costa del Sol's best golf courses. The development introduces a flexible ownership model: live in your residence whenever you wish, and opt into professional rental management for the rest of the year. Residents also have access to landscaped gardens, indoor and outdoor pools, a gym, restaurant, cinema room, coworking space and a kids' club.
why: Golf Valley Flex Residences suits buyers who want the flexibility to live in their home part-time while generating rental income the rest of the year, in one of Marbella's most established golf addresses.
location: Golf Valley Flex Residences sits in Nueva Andalucía's Golf Valley, surrounded by some of the Costa del Sol's best golf courses and minutes from Puerto Banús.

name: Fairway Grove Villas
constructionStatus: Off-plan, building licence granted and active, delivery Phase 1 Summer 2027 / Phase 2 Q4 2027
description: A collection of 14 detached villas at El Campanario, on the New Golden Mile, with golf and country club membership included.
overview: Fairway Grove Villas is a collection of 14 detached villas at El Campanario, on the New Golden Mile between Puerto Banús and Estepona. The villas are arranged in three sizes -- Premium, Deluxe and Superior -- sharing the same contemporary design language of travertine-clad volumes, white render and full-height glazing. Every villa comes with a private pool, a rooftop solarium with a jacuzzi, and an annual membership to the golf and country club at the centre of the urbanisation, giving owners use of the 9-hole golf course, gym, spa, indoor pool and restaurant without a separate membership fee.
why: A villa collection built around a golf and country club membership, aimed at buyers who want new-build specification without giving up a resort-style amenity offer.
location: The villas sit inside the El Campanario golf urbanisation on the New Golden Mile, between Puerto Banús and Estepona, with the golf clubhouse a short walk away and the beach a few minutes' drive.

name: Cielo Alto Residences
constructionStatus: under_construction
description: A collection of 17 duplex Sky Villas on an elevated plot in Benahavis, in the Golden Triangle between Marbella, Benahavis and Estepona, with a shared clubhouse and private lift access.
overview: Cielo Alto Residences is a collection of 17 duplex Sky Villas set within six boutique buildings on an elevated plot in Benahavis, in the Golden Triangle between Marbella, Benahavis and Estepona. Five buildings hold three Sky Villas each, and the sixth holds two. Each residence spans one or two full floors with its own private lift running from the living floors down to a private garage, combining the scale of a villa with the security of an apartment. Terraces are large and south-facing, with the option to add a private pool, and residents share a Sky Villa pool and a clubhouse with an indoor pool, spa, gym and coworking space.
why: A duplex villa collection for buyers who want villa-scale living with the security and lift access of an apartment building.
location: Cielo Alto sits on an elevated plot in Benahavis, in the Golden Triangle between Marbella, Benahavis village and Estepona, close to La Quinta golf and a short drive from Puerto Banús and the coast.

name: Elviria Woodland Residences
constructionStatus: Under construction
description: A collection of 21 apartments across seven independent buildings set within a private Mediterranean forest in Elviria, Marbella East, with a private pool at every residence.
overview: Elviria Woodland Residences is a collection of 21 apartments spread across seven independent buildings, set within a private Mediterranean forest in Elviria, Marbella East, surrounded by pines, mastic trees and rosemary, and crossed by a natural stream. Ground-floor residences open onto a front and rear garden; first-floor residences have their own rooftop terrace with a pergola, and one building is built exclusively as a duplex with its own solarium. Every residence, on any floor, has its own private swimming pool. A footbridge over the stream leads to a shared Wellness Hub with a dry sauna, hammam, gym and outdoor fitness area.
why: A low-rise apartment collection for buyers who want a private pool and a genuinely wooded, natural setting close to Marbella's east-side beaches and golf courses.
location: Elviria Woodland sits within its own pine forest in Elviria, on Marbella's east side, close to Santa Maria Golf and Cabopino Golf and a short drive from Marbella old town and Puerto Banús.

name: Miramar Urban Residences
constructionStatus: Under construction, building licence granted and active
description: A 233-home urban resort in Las Lagunas, Mijas, between Fuengirola and Mijas, with two outdoor pools, a rooftop skypool, spa, gym and coworking space.
overview: Miramar Urban Residences is a 233-home development in Las Lagunas, the most active and commercial district of Mijas, sitting between Fuengirola and Mijas town. The development spans several buildings arranged around landscaped communal gardens, with apartments and penthouses from 2 to 4 bedrooms. Residents share two outdoor pools connected by a water feature, a rooftop skypool with coastal views, an indoor spa with a heated pool, a fully equipped gym and a coworking space -- amenities designed to bring a resort-style routine to everyday life, a short walk from the Parque Comercial Miramar shopping and leisure centre and five minutes' drive from Fuengirola.
why: A large-scale urban resort for buyers who want hotel-style amenities and easy walkable access to everyday shops and leisure, without leaving the Costa del Sol.
location: Miramar Urban Residences sits in Las Lagunas, the most active district of Mijas, between the coastal towns of Fuengirola and Mijas. The Parque Comercial Miramar shopping and leisure centre sits directly opposite the development, with Fuengirola's centre five minutes away by car.

name: Cerrado Vista Residences
constructionStatus: Under construction, building licence granted
description: A collection of 71 apartments and penthouses across 6 buildings on a hilltop plot in Mijas, next to Cerrado del Aguila Golf Club, with panoramic sea, golf and mountain views and a full resort-style amenity floor.
overview: Cerrado Vista Residences is a collection of 71 apartments and penthouses across 6 buildings on a hilltop plot in Mijas, directly next to Cerrado del Aguila Golf Club, with views that stretch from the Mediterranean coastline to the surrounding hills. Every residence is designed around floor-to-ceiling glazing and generous terraces, from 1-bedroom apartments to 4-bedroom penthouses, with a shared amenity floor that includes two outdoor pools, spa, gym, coworking space and a community gastro-bar.
why: A resort-style apartment collection for buyers who want hotel-level amenities and panoramic views without leaving Mijas' golf coast.
location: Cerrado Vista sits on a hilltop plot in Mijas, directly next to Cerrado del Aguila Golf Club, within easy reach of La Cala de Mijas, Fuengirola and Marbella.

name: Guadalobon Beach Residences
constructionStatus: Off-plan, building licence requested
